Operator approved the store/provider/schedule items of design §11 on 2026-10-31 ("I approve and agree to everything one through eight"). Advisory data only; MBI_BEHAVIOR = 0.
_feed_note: Measured 2026-10-31 (review of #2384, H2): feed=sip on the current credentials returns full 04:00-20:00 ET coverage when the request ends at least 16 minutes before now (the free plan's SIP delay). The earlier 'IEX only 16:00-17:00 / 08:00-09:30' note was wrong for this feed choice.

overnight._why: 2026-10-31 operator: the Market Risk Engine must see the overnight session and index futures from the Sunday 18:00 ET open ("No excuses"). Two sessions added to the store by migrations/2026_10_31_market_quotes_extended_overnight.sql, defined in scripts/lib/overnight_session.py: overnight = afterhours_close_et (20:00) to premarket_open_et (04:00) ET, Sunday 20:00 to Friday 04:00 (none Friday 20:00 to Sunday 20:00); futures_open = Sunday futures_open_et (18:00) to 20:00 ET, futures only, kept apart so an 'overnight' row always lies in 20:00-04:00. session_date = the NEXT NYSE trading day (the session the night leads into; market_session.market_holidays, the market_day_gate.sh calendar); the reference is the close of the trading day before it. A 04:00:00 print is premarket.

_symbols_note: 2026-10-31 off-hours collector (PR #2416): DIA, RSP, SOXX and XLK added so the engine's full index, breadth and sector proxy set is collected; the Schwab extended-hours lane reads this same list (config/market_risk_offhours_quotes.yaml universe.sources).
